test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

A new invention has been made by him.

options.text: He was making a new invention.
He had been making a new invention.
He has made a new invention.
He were making a new invention.

solution:
The correct answer is **"He has made a new invention."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The given sentence is in Present Perfect Tense and Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Perfect Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• Subject is "A new invention" and object is "him" in active voice.
 
• So, the subject is "he" and object is "a new invention" in passive voice.
 
• Structure__:
 __
 
• Subject + has/have + V3 + Object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject __(Passive Voice)__
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Disha has arranged the things. *(Active Voice)
 
• *The things have been arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

 

​​Correct sentence: *He has made a new invention*.
